name: Integration Orbit
description: Integration icons orbit a glowing hub on two tilted rings with depth-scaled size and correct front/back layering; data pulses travel into the hub, which ripples on each arrival.
move: Integration icons orbit a glowing hub on two tilted rings with depth-scaled size and correct front/back layering; data pulses travel into the hub, which ripples on each arrival.
how: Deterministic draw(t). Nodes ride rotated ellipses; sin(θ) is depth, driving scale, brightness and z-index (front nodes draw over the hub, back ones under). Pulses are SVG lines with a glowing dot on an in-out cubic; ripples are scaling rounded squares.
adapt: Swap the generic glyphs for your integration marks; adjust ORBITS radii, tilt and speed. Placeholder product names and copy are generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Pure draw(t): mount the markup in the shot and call draw from the film's frame hook with shot-local time; wait for fonts before sampling or measuring.
caveats: Original implementation; no third-party UI kit, product or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
